item.title: Some Thoughts on Platform Construction
item.description: 1. Only Platformization Lets You Go Further As long as you respond to the market a little faster than your competitors and live a little longer, you can win more room to survive. A brilliant business model or market opportunity is more like magic: it can grow a company fast, but it is not something human effort can control.
